fixed_before_measuring: 2026-10-10, after the 5-minute no-DIB baseline (experiments_tnsm/node_baseline/baseline_noDIB.json), before any M1/M2 cell
rule: a cell is flagged as disturbed if, over the cell window, other_cores > max_other_cores OR steal_pct > max_steal_pct; flagged cells are never dropped: results are reported on all cells and on unflagged cells, with the flagged count
other_cores_definition: CPU of user-space processes other than the measuring process (kernel threads excluded, reported as kernel_cores)
rationale: 1.0 core = 3.6x the baseline maximum and 8x its median: another tenant taking a whole vCPU; 2% steal = 50x the baseline maximum: hypervisor contention
